name: straw-boss-desk
description: Builds a pi coding stack on a bare machine and opens the pi-straw-boss GUI as its main window.
author: straw-boss-desk

scripts.build: node scripts/desk-tokens.ts --check && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json
